item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go
item.description:
The Durable Task SDK for Go is now in public preview. It lets developers write orchestrations, activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler handling execution history and work dispatch.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Golang support on Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Go support on Azure Functions Flex Consumption is now generally available. It provides a code-first model with typed Go handlers, standard Go modules, and integration with Azure Functions Core Tools and Azure CLI.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: devops+ai: Authenticode Signing Windows Binaries From GitHub Actions
item.description:
The article describes a workflow for Authenticode-signing Windows binaries from GitHub Actions. It mentions using Go, Azure HSMs, and a multi-OS build/sign/publish setup, including PE header hash signing.

  • Source: Let’s do DevOps

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.2 improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript analysis
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.2 is available with a new C++ regular-expression parser and analysis improvements for C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript. The update applies to the static analysis engine used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub
